name: mcp-alertmanager

Error: failed to resolve Alertmanager connection: no Alertmanager connection available

No direct URL provided and no Kubernetes cluster detected.

Configure one of the following:

  # Direct URL (testing/dev)
  mcp-alertmanager --url http://localhost:9093

  # Environment variable
  ALERTMANAGER_URL=http://alertmanager:9093 mcp-alertmanager

  # Kubernetes auto-detect with defaults (openshift-monitoring/alertmanager-operated:9093)

  mcp-alertmanager

  # Custom namespace/service
  mcp-alertmanager --namespace openshift-monitoring --service alertmanager-operated

  # Explicit kubeconfig
  mcp-alertmanager --kubeconfig /path/to/kubeconfig
Usage:
  mcp-alertmanager [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help                    help for mcp-alertmanager
      --kubeconfig string       Path to kubeconfig file (default: auto-detect)
      --log-level int           Set the log level (from 0 to 9)
      --namespace string        Kubernetes namespace for Alertmanager service (default: openshift-monitoring)
      --port string             Start a streamable HTTP server on the specified port (e.g. 8080)
      --service string          Kubernetes service name for Alertmanager (default: alertmanager-operated)
      --service-port string     Kubernetes service port for Alertmanager (default: 9093)
      --service-scheme string   Kubernetes service scheme: http or https (default: https)
      --url string              Direct Alertmanager URL (e.g. http://localhost:9093). Overrides K8S auto-detect. Env: ALERTMANAGER_URL
      --version                 Print version information and quit
